cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll introduce you to the curator if you hang my exhibition. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hang it Saturday. Can you send her portfolio requirements now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Of course. Could you collect my frames too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Give me her email; I'll ask her directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct access includes taking the show down. Shall I put you down for Sunday?

mechanism: A manages curator access while yielding exhibition-work timing and practical arrangements but charging new obligations for requirements, contact and direct introduction.
confusable: Unlike ordinary reciprocal favors, every access layer becomes another price; confidence depends on B accepting a negotiated workable schedule.
comparison: Professional introduction and show labor differ from immediate cleanup and a storeroom key.
seedUse: Use D70-b curator/hanging/requirements/frames/email/takedown with S02-a adopting partner availability within a controlled access plan.
